name: verse_meta_on_verse_insert
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER verse_meta_on_verse_insert
            AFTER INSERT ON verse
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO verse_meta
                    (verse_id, testament, language, chapter, verse_num, created_at, deleted)
                SELECT
                    NEW.id,
                    CASE WHEN (SELECT ordinal FROM cfg_book_order
                               WHERE book = substr(NEW.osisId, 1, instr(NEW.osisId,'.')-1)) <= 38
                         THEN 'OT' ELSE 'NT' END,
                    CASE WHEN (SELECT ordinal FROM cfg_book_order
                               WHERE book = substr(NEW.osisId, 1, instr(NEW.osisId,'.')-1)) <= 38
                         THEN 'Hebrew' ELSE 'Greek' END,
                    CAST(substr(NEW.osisId, instr(NEW.osisId,'.')+1,
                         instr(substr(NEW.osisId, instr(NEW.osisId,'.')+1),'.')-1) AS INTEGER),
                    CAST(substr(NEW.osisId, instr(NEW.osisId,'.')+1
                         + instr(substr(NEW.osisId, instr(NEW.osisId,'.')+1),'.')) AS INTEGER),
                    strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now'), NEW.deleted;
            END
use: keeps verse_meta in step when a verse row is inserted

name: verse_meta_on_verse_deleted
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER verse_meta_on_verse_deleted
            AFTER UPDATE OF deleted ON verse
            WHEN NEW.deleted != OLD.deleted
            BEGIN
                UPDATE verse_meta SET deleted = NEW.deleted, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now')
                WHERE verse_id = NEW.id;
            END
use: keeps verse_meta in step when a verse is soft-deleted

name: verse_meta_on_passage_change
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER verse_meta_on_passage_change
            AFTER INSERT ON verse_passage
            WHEN NEW.deleted = 0
            BEGIN
                UPDATE verse_meta SET
                    passage_id = NEW.passage_id,
                    is_passage_anchor = NEW.is_anchor,
                    updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now')
                WHERE verse_id = NEW.verse_id;
            END
use: keeps verse_meta in step when verse_passage changes

name: verse_meta_on_lexical_change
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER verse_meta_on_lexical_change
            AFTER INSERT ON verse_lexical
            WHEN NEW.deleted = 0 AND NEW.strong IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                UPDATE verse_meta SET
                    language = (
                        SELECT s.language FROM verse_lexical vl
                        JOIN strong s ON s.strongNumber = vl.strong
                        WHERE vl.verse_id = NEW.verse_id AND vl.deleted = 0
                        AND s.language IS NOT NULL
                        GROUP BY s.language ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.language LIMIT 1
                    ),
                    updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now')
                WHERE verse_id = NEW.verse_id;
            END
use: keeps verse_meta in step when verse_lexical changes

name: wa_verse_records_updated_at

CREATE TRIGGER wa_verse_records_updated_at
AFTER UPDATE ON wa_verse_records
BEGIN
    UPDATE wa_verse_records
    SET updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S','now')
    WHERE id = NEW.id;
END
use: stamps wa_verse_records.updated_at on update

name: wa_quality_flag_types_cascade_delete
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER wa_quality_flag_types_cascade_delete
AFTER UPDATE OF delete_flagged ON wa_quality_flag_types
WHEN NEW.delete_flagged = 1 AND OLD.delete_flagged = 0
BEGIN
    UPDATE wa_data_quality_flags SET delete_flagged = 1 WHERE flag_id = NEW.id;
END

CREATE TRIGGER prose_section_ai AFTER INSERT ON prose_section BEGIN

name: prose_section_au
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER prose_section_au AFTER UPDATE ON prose_section BEGIN
        DELETE FROM prose_section_fts WHERE rowid = old.id;
        INSERT INTO prose_section_fts(rowid, body, heading, section_type_code,
                                      registry_id, cluster_code, characteristic_id, status)
        VALUES (new.id, new.body, new.heading,
                (SELECT code FROM "prose_section_type" WHERE id=new.section_type_id),
                new.registry_id, new.cluster_code, new.characteristic_id, new.status);
    END
use: keeps prose_section_fts in step on update

name: trg_narrative_claim_ref_ai
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_narrative_claim_ref_ai AFTER INSERT ON narrative_claim WHEN NEW.claim_ref IS NULL
BEGIN
  UPDATE narrative_claim SET claim_ref = 'C-' || NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.id;
END
use: a new claim with no claim_ref is given C-{id} (spec sec3.3) -- escalation #2110

name: trg_narrative_claim_ai
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_narrative_claim_ai AFTER INSERT ON narrative_claim
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO narrative_claim_change (claim_id, change_date, change_kind, claim_after, verdict_after, chapter_id, section_id, basis, provenance, created_by)
  VALUES (NEW.id, substr(NEW.created_at, 1, 10), 'claim created', NEW.claim_text, NEW.verdict, NEW.main_chapter_id, NEW.main_section_id, 'direct edit', 'trigger trg_narrative_claim_ai', 'trigger');
END
use: every new claim writes its 'claim created' change row -- escalation #2110

name: trg_narrative_claim_text_au
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_narrative_claim_text_au AFTER UPDATE OF claim_text ON narrative_claim WHEN OLD.claim_text IS NOT NEW.claim_text
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO narrative_claim_change (claim_id, change_date, change_kind, claim_before, claim_after, basis, provenance, created_by)
  VALUES (NEW.id, date('now'), 'edited', OLD.claim_text, NEW.claim_text, 'direct edit', 'trigger trg_narrative_claim_text_au', 'trigger');
END
use: a change to a claim's wording writes its before and after (test plan 2.4) -- escalation #2110

name: trg_narrative_claim_status_au
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_narrative_claim_status_au AFTER UPDATE OF status ON narrative_claim WHEN OLD.status IS NOT NEW.status
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO narrative_claim_change (claim_id, change_date, change_kind, claim_before, claim_after, note, basis, provenance, created_by)
  VALUES (NEW.id, date('now'), CASE NEW.status WHEN 'withdrawn' THEN 'claim withdrawn' ELSE 'edited' END, NEW.claim_text, NEW.claim_text, 'status: ' || OLD.status || ' -> ' || NEW.status, 'direct edit', 'trigger trg_narrative_claim_status_au', 'trigger');
END
use: a change of status (withdrawn, held, current) is logged -- escalation #2110

name: trg_narrative_passage_text_au
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_narrative_passage_text_au AFTER UPDATE OF passage_text ON narrative_passage WHEN OLD.passage_text IS NOT NEW.passage_text
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO narrative_claim_change (claim_id, passage_id, change_date, change_kind, passage_before, passage_after, chapter_id, section_id, basis, provenance, created_by)
  SELECT t.claim_id, NEW.id, date('now'), 'telling changed', OLD.passage_text, NEW.passage_text, NEW.chapter_id, NEW.section_id, 'direct edit', 'trigger trg_narrative_passage_text_au', 'trigger' FROM narrative_claim_telling t WHERE t.passage_id = NEW.id AND t.status = 'current';
END
use: a change to a passage writes one row per claim it tells, with the passage before and after (test plan 2.6) -- escalation #2110

name: trg_narrative_passage_move_au
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_narrative_passage_move_au AFTER UPDATE OF chapter_id, section_id ON narrative_passage WHEN (OLD.chapter_id IS NOT NEW.chapter_id OR OLD.section_id IS NOT NEW.section_id) AND NOT (OLD.chapter_id IS NEW.chapter_id AND (SELECT renamed_from_id FROM narrative_section WHERE id = NEW.section_id) IS OLD.section_id)
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO narrative_claim_change (claim_id, passage_id, change_date, change_kind, passage_after, chapter_id, section_id, section_before_id, note, basis, provenance, created_by)
  SELECT t.claim_id, NEW.id, date('now'), 'passage moved', NEW.passage_text, NEW.chapter_id, NEW.section_id, OLD.section_id, 'moved from chapter id ' || OLD.chapter_id, 'direct edit', 'trigger trg_narrative_passage_move_au', 'trigger' FROM narrative_claim_telling t WHERE t.passage_id = NEW.id AND t.status = 'current';
END
use: a passage moved to another chapter or section keeps its row and its claims; the move is logged with where from (spec sec3.1). A heading renamed in place (the new section row's renamed_from_id is the old one) is not a move -- escalation #2110

name: trg_narrative_passage_retire_au
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_narrative_passage_retire_au AFTER UPDATE OF last_version ON narrative_passage WHEN (OLD.last_version IS NULL) <> (NEW.last_version IS NULL)
BEGIN
  UPDATE narrative_claim SET in_narrative = (SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM narrative_claim_telling t JOIN narrative_passage p ON p.id = t.passage_id WHERE t.claim_id = narrative_claim.id AND t.status = 'current' AND t.kind <> 'pointer' AND p.last_version IS NULL)) WHERE id IN (SELECT claim_id FROM narrative_claim_telling WHERE passage_id = NEW.id);
END
use: a passage that leaves (or returns to) the current narrative updates in_narrative of the claims it tells (test plan 2.9) -- escalation #2110

BEGIN

END
